title: Beyond the browning index: RGB radiomics enables non-destructive prediction of fresh-cut "Red Fuji" apple browning and enzyme activities

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Beyond the browning index: RGB radiomics enables non-destructive prediction of fresh-cut "Red Fuji" apple browning and enzyme activities》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-9】These results suggest that radiomic features extracted from low-cost RGB images may provide a useful approach for estimating browning and selected enzyme activities in fresh-cut 'Red Fuji' apples under the conditions investigated.

evidence.text: These results suggest that radiomic features extracted from low-cost RGB images may provide a useful approach for estimating browning and selected enzyme activities in fresh-cut 'Red Fuji' apples under the conditions investigated.

sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《Beyond the browning index: RGB radiomics enables non-destructive prediction of fresh-cut "Red Fuji" apple browning and enzyme activities》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Abstract · abstract-1-8】The best single models achieved R2 of 0.909 (Time), 0.966 (BI), 0.950 (PPO), and 0.918 (POD), while ensemble learning consistently delivered robust performance with R2 generally >0.90 (e.g., voting: 0.913 for Time, 0.972 for BI, 0.924 for POD).

sections.title: 复现线索
sections.text:
《Beyond the browning index: RGB radiomics enables non-destructive prediction of fresh-cut "Red Fuji" apple browning and enzyme activities》：复现时可直接核对的数据、软件或实现线索。

【Abstract · abstract-1-5】Browning regions were automatically cropped from the original photo, and high-throughput radiomic features were extracted from regions of interest with PyRadiomics, including first-order statistics, 2D shape descriptors, and multi-scale texture features from original, wavelet-transformed, and 2D local binary pattern (LBP2D) images.
